$comment: Move R28's via out of its pad. An unplugged via inside an SMD pad drains
solder down the barrel during reflow; a 0.3 mm barrel can swallow more volume
than a small pad's entire paste deposit, which is how you get a joint that
looks fine and is not. R28.2 escapes 0.8 mm north-west to open copper.
U1.93 (the other BTN1 via) could NOT be fixed and is left as-is -- see the
plan. It sits in a 0.28 x 2.0 mm QFP pad on 0.5 mm pitch, with a +3V3 diagonal
1.6 mm east and a GND trace 0.295 mm west, so there is nowhere to escape to.
